title: ROS computer IP identified as 192.168.64.20
evidence: slam-ros robot-settings: etc/network/interfaces (br0 address 192.168.64.20, bridge eth0+eth1); etc/init/keenonrobot.conf (env ROS_IP=192.168.64.20, execs roslaunch keenon_robot.launch); corroborated by 2 independently-built APKs (SDK REMOTE_LINK_PROXY=192.168.64.20).
notes: Re-derived from network config + launch mechanism, not assumed from prior finding. Static-only; not live-confirmed.

title: ROS Master URI = http://192.168.64.20:11311
evidence: slam-ros robot-settings usr/bin/keenonrobot_setup.sh line 5 (export ROS_MASTER_URI=http://192.168.64.20:11311) and its duplicate to_abandon/keenonrobot_setup.sh; remote-tools usr/bin/rosenv --remote (export ROS_MASTER_URI='http://192.168.64.20:11311'); upstart keenonrobot.conf sets ROS_IP=.20 and roslaunch binds master on :11311 by convention.
notes: Literal present in technician tools; the daemon start script sets ROS_IP and lets roslaunch bind the master. Port 11311 is ROS default. Static-only.

title: Android tablet IP = 192.168.64.10 and acts as default gateway for the ROS PC
evidence: slam-ros robot-settings etc/init/net_gw.conf (ip route add default via 192.168.64.10 dev br0); Peanut SDK constant LOCAL_ETHER_IP=192.168.64.10 (both APKs); ros_update strings reference 192.168.64.10.
notes: Unusual design: ROS PC egresses to Internet through the tablet.

title: rosbridge WebSocket on 192.168.64.20:9090 (data) and :9091 (control, unauthenticated)
evidence: robot_common.launch includes rosbridge_websocket.launch and rosbridge_websocket_control.launch (port=9091, address="", ssl=false, authenticate=false, ns=control) + rosapi_node; robotviz Home.js/index.js hard-code ws://192.168.64.20:9090 and :9091; installation-assistant RosSocketClientManager.ADDRESS relays to same.
notes: Default port 9090 comes from upstream rosbridge_server (not shipped) -> INFERRED for exact 9090; 9091 CONFIRMED from launch args. Live exposure UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME.

title: Peanut SDK command transports to ROS PC: CoAP 5683, HTTP 54322/34569, push-WS 22345/12386, TFTP 9527 (no auth/TLS)
evidence: Decompiled PeanutConstants in both APKs: COAP_PORT=5683, HTTP_PORT=54322, HTTP_PORT_UPGRADE=34569, WS_PORT=22345, WS_PORT_UPGRADE=12386, TFTP_PORT=9527, REMOTE_LINK_PROXY=192.168.64.20; peanut-clean CoAP call chains (startClean->/clean/dstV2, /charge/auto, /devices/reboot).
notes: No credential field in HttpRequestBody; schemes coap/http/ws/tftp. Security relies on isolated LAN.

title: CoAP bridge node direction confirmed (only node with explicit pub/sub)
evidence: coap_bridge_server strings (QLDownloadClient); libcoap_bridge.so symbol classes (CleanResource, NavigationResource, MotorResource, PositionResource, ...).
notes: Downloads into /etc/ros/runtime/..., /tmp/robot/, /work/robot/ via libcurl; composes sudo shell commands (injection-relevant, ROS-046).

title: ros_update OTA HTTP service on the ROS PC, runs as root
value: HTTP upgrade/action, upgrade/status (port 9527 inferred from adjacent literal; 9013 also seen)
evidence: usr/bin/ros_update strings: http://0.0.0.0:, upgrade/action, upgrade/status, 192.168.64.10, 9527; classes QLUpdateResource (update_ros_from_zip, update_stm32_from_bin, install_package, restart_ros), KeenonShell(sudo_exec_cmd); upstart ros_update.conf runs as root, respawn unlimited.
notes: Port exact value UNKNOWN/INFERRED; auth behaviour NOT_ANALYZED.

title: C40 ROS node set determined from launch profile
value: ~35 always-on + conditional nodes (chassis, peanut_localization, gmapping, cartographer_1, move_base[kplanner+TEB], cover_planner, task_manager, task_dispatcher, interactive, web_backend, database, coap_bridge_server, rosbridge, keenon_vslam, fdl_ros, sy_tof_dev, micro_laser x3, lora_driver, elevator_task, ...)
evidence: robot_common.launch resolved with keenon_robot_C40.launch args (ROBOT_TYPE=C40, LIDAR_TYPE=free, MONO=true, VSLAM=false, USE_CAMERA=false, USE_TOF=true, USE_CLEAN=true, USE_DROP_RESISTENT=true, USE_LASER_BACK=true).
notes: STATIC_REFERENCE from launch XML; which launch actually runs on a unit is UNKNOWN (package default is W3). UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME.

title: C40 sensing is Sunny ToF + FDL mono/depth, NOT the astra/berxel RGB-D cameras
evidence: keenon_robot_C40.launch args; astra/berxel camera nodes present in package but not launched for C40.
notes: Corrects any assumption the C40 uses astra/berxel cameras; it uses ToF (sy_tof) + mono VSLAM module + FDL cliff depth.

evidence: ELF string harvest (names beginning '/') + pkg/Type strings; ros_packages.md 5.2 and scratch an/topics.json.
notes: Name presence != advertised at runtime; pub/sub direction UNKNOWN; topic<->type pairing mostly INFERRED by convention. See ROS_TOPICS_INVENTORY.md.

title: STM32/GD32 serial bridge topics on chassis node
evidence: chassis binary string table; firmware framing AA AA..55 55 CRC16 0xA001, 128-byte IAP packets (FW-016/017); /dev/ttyUSBSchedule 921600.
notes: Direction inferred from up/down naming. Cleaning actuators bridged here.

title: Network LiDAR endpoints (sensor IPs, not computers)
notes: These are LiDAR devices on the robot LAN, not the ROS computer.

title: Developer/test endpoints left in shipped artifacts
value: ws://172.16.8.13:9092 (dev workstation, in robotviz+installation-assistant SPA bundle); http://172.16.8.102:8089, ws://192.168.2.5:8083, upload-test.keenonai.com (peanut-clean dev.config.json/test.config.json); http://192.168.2.218:8090 (dustBox.html image host); 192.168.64.199:9090 (calibration config.json default)
evidence: minified JS bundles and dev/test config assets.
notes: Not part of the robot's own runtime network; quality/info-leak defects. Dev configs are not the production domain.json.

title: Android tablet reaches ROS PC directly; no separate gateway computer
value: tablet(.10) <-> ROS PC(.20) on one L2 segment; REMOTE_LINK_PROXY == ROS PC
evidence: SDK constants; flat br0 bridge; rosbridge + CoAP both terminate on .20.
notes: Architecture: Android Tablet -> (flat 192.168.64.0/24 LAN) -> ROS Computer -> nodes -> hardware. No intermediate proxy box.
